newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes firm ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes firm ahead of weekend.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso closed 3.3 centavos firmer at 7.7120/7.7170 on Friday, due to local and foreign dealers selling dollars to invest in the Mexican money market over the weekend, traders said.
"The market opened with dealers buying (dollars), but they began to sell to invest in Cetes over the weekend," said a trader.
Traders added the same-day rate also firmed as it had lagged behind other contracts on Thursday.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart, were 1.4 and 2.3 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.7320/7.7370 and 7.7270/7.7310 per dollar.
The market was quiet as the peso appeared to have settled down after the whirlwind of speculation and panic that affected the market earlier this week.
"The market feels very calm at these levels...the exchange rate could begin to consolidate soon," said a trader.
